content.short: Aboard Exchange is an order-book perpetual DEX featuring an on-chain broker model that rewards users and partners across multiple blockchain networks.
content.description: Aboard Exchange is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange combining a traditional order-book matching model with an innovative on-chain broker system that distributes referral and partner rewards transparently via smart contracts. The broker model creates a community-driven growth flywheel by incentivizing ecosystem partners to bring liquidity and traders to the platform. Aboard supports multiple blockchains including Mantle, offering a wide selection of perpetual contracts with competitive fee structures.
content.meta: Aboard Exchange is an order-book perp DEX with an on-chain broker reward model on Mantle. Discover Aboard on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
